payload.title: Parametrize the unified harness per corpus; planted-bias replays keep passing
payload.description:
## Purpose

Parametrize the unified harness per corpus so bios runs alongside the default planted-bias corpus.

## Scope

A corpus spec (items, labels, splits, rubric seed, prompts, twin pairing) selected by a CLI option; planted-bias remains the default with unchanged behaviour. Starting point depends on the owner's resume-vs-restart answer. Corpus fixtures in Jev-Flywheel are read-only.

## Definition of done

Specs for both corpora; all existing planted-bias replays reproduce byte-identical summaries; `make test` green. Cost: $0.
